subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The (friendly) dog wagged its tail, while the ________ cat hissed.
solution:
The correct answer is: **hostile**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Friendly **means having a kind, amicable, or warm disposition; and showing a willingness to be helpful or supportive. (मित्रतापूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example**: *Sarah is known for her friendly demeanour; she always greets everyone with a smile and is eager to help.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Hostile **means unfriendliness, aggression, or opposition; showing strong animosity or opposition. (शत्रुतापूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example**: *The negotiations took a hostile turn when the parties could not agree on key terms.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence**: The friendly dog wagged its tail, while the hostile __cat hissed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Loving**: Showing a deep affection or warm attachment; having a strong feeling of affection and care. (अनुरागशील)
 
• **Welcoming**: Creating an atmosphere of hospitality and friendliness; inviting and receptive to others. (अभिवादन करना)
 
• **Affectionate**: Expressing fondness, tenderness, or love; showing warmth and care towards others. (स्नेहशील)
